description: Habit tracker widget for the Windows 10 and 11 desktop. Tracks several goals and streaks on a 20-week grid like a contribution graph, with weekly targets, per-goal color themes and a global hotkey. PowerShell and WinForms, no install, no dependencies.
release_title: v1.1.0: no more blinking shadows, crash insulation, new README
release_notes:
Update to the June version. Your `data.json` is untouched (same format).

- Fixed: window shadows no longer blink. The widget is sunk to the bottom only when something was actually raised above it.
- Added: crash insulation. A stray exception in a paint, timer or click is logged to `%APPDATA%\HabitWidget\widget.log` instead of closing the widget.
- Added: off-screen guard. A saved position that no longer fits the monitor layout is moved onto the primary screen.
- Docs: rewritten README (install, usage, privacy, troubleshooting), CHANGELOG, new screenshots.

Install: download `habit-tracker-widget-v1.1.0.zip`, extract it anywhere, run `install.bat`. Windows 10 or 11, Windows PowerShell 5.1, no admin rights.
